description: Get the current 2FA code (the 6 digits an authenticator app shows) for a login in your owner's Vault, when a site you are signing in to asks for one. Pass `name` = a login from `list_capabilities` whose `hasTotp` is true. Returns `code` and `secondsLeft` (how long it stays valid; if it is under 5, wait and call again). Type the code into the site's 2FA field on that login's own site only. The 2FA setup key itself is never shared. Same authorization rule as `pull_capability`: only when your OWNER directs you to sign in, in THIS thread. If the login has no 2FA key saved, ask your owner for the code.

name.description: The exact login name as shown by list_capabilities (e.g. "linkedin.com").

name: login_code
